sources.title: AI Arduino IDE - Online Arduino IDE with AI | Codey Online
sources.snippet: The Arduino IDE, reimagined with AI The classic Arduino IDE is a plain text editor. Codey Online is a modern, browser-based IDE with an AI pair-programmer built in. It writes sketches, explains errors, manages libraries and keeps a per-project file tree - so you spend time building, not configuring toolchains.
